WITH selected_lines AS ( SELECT id, calc_item_id FROM pur_order_item WHERE
id IN #{id}
false
), source_items AS ( -- 自身来源不受算料状态限制；在途使用者只认已确认的算料单。 -- UNION 对同一采购行/算料行去重，防自身来源也使用了该采购行时重复。 SELECT l.id AS line_id, ci.id AS calc_item_id, ci.calc_id, ci.order_nos, ci.style_codes FROM selected_lines l JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = l.calc_item_id UNION SELECT l.id AS line_id, ci.id AS calc_item_id, ci.calc_id, ci.order_nos, ci.style_codes FROM selected_lines l JOIN mrp_calc_transit t ON t.purchase_item_id = l.id JOIN mrp_calc_item ci ON ci.id = t.calc_item_id JOIN mrp_calc c ON c.id = ci.calc_id AND c.status = 'CONFIRMED' ), source_totals AS ( SELECT line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT calc_id) AS sources_total, MIN(calc_id) AS first_calc_id FROM source_items GROUP BY line_id ), source_tokens AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.line_id, 'ORDER'::text AS kind, btrim(token.value, E' 	
') AS code FROM source_items s CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(s.order_nos, ',')) token(value) WHERE btrim(token.value, E' 	
') <> '' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT s.line_id, 'STYLE'::text AS kind, btrim(token.value, E' 	
') AS code FROM source_items s CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(s.style_codes, ',')) token(value) WHERE btrim(token.value, E' 	
') <> '' ), ranked_tokens AS ( SELECT line_id, kind, code, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY line_id, kind) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY line_id, kind ORDER BY code) AS position FROM source_tokens ), limited_tokens AS ( SELECT line_id, kind, code, total FROM ranked_tokens WHERE position <= LEAST(GREATEST(#{limit}, 1), 20) ), previews AS ( -- 只有每类最多 20 个去重编号进入 string_agg，不聚合完整来源文本。 SELECT line_id, string_agg(code, ',' ORDER BY code) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'ORDER') AS order_nos, MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'ORDER') AS order_nos_total, string_agg(code, ',' ORDER BY code) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'STYLE') AS style_codes, MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'STYLE') AS style_codes_total FROM limited_tokens GROUP BY line_id ) SELECT l.id AS line_id, COALESCE(owner_calc.no, first_calc.no) AS calc_no, COALESCE(t.sources_total, 0) AS sources_total, p.order_nos, COALESCE(p.order_nos_total, 0) AS order_nos_total, p.style_codes, COALESCE(p.style_codes_total, 0) AS style_codes_total FROM selected_lines l LEFT JOIN mrp_calc_item owner_item ON owner_item.id = l.calc_item_id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc owner_calc ON owner_calc.id = owner_item.calc_id LEFT JOIN source_totals t ON t.line_id = l.id LEFT JOIN mrp_calc first_calc ON first_calc.id = t.first_calc_id LEFT JOIN previews p ON p.line_id = l.id ORDER BY l.id
